Markus: can you pre-authorize up to $8k in provisional credits on GF-3249? Jordan: please flag any support tickets and collect request-level traces if possible. Subject: Re: Unexpected duplicate charges on June usage

Hi Sasha — quick update and next steps. First, I'm sorry for the disruption; we understand how disruptive unexpected charges are.

What we found so far: our infra team has identified an internal retry loop that, under a narrow sequence-length and batched-requests condition, caused a subset of streaming responses to be reprocessed and counted twice for roughly 45 minutes on 2026-06-26. The root cause is an edge condition in the KV-cache invalidation path during a rolling kernel swap.

Immediate remediation taken: the retry guard was deployed at 05:12 UTC the same day and we have a long-running job performing a canonical recount of your tokenized requests. Preliminary delta: ~1,920,000 tokens over the window (approx $4,600 at your rate).

Provisional remediation we are offering today:
- Immediate provisional credit of $4,600 issued against the June invoice (attached provisional credit note).
- Final reconciliation after the recount; we will either adjust up or down and issue any additional credit or invoice correction.
- Full postmortem and technical summary available by 2026-06-30 (link will be shared).

Attachments: redwood_credit_note_GF3249.pdf (provisional credit).

If that plan works for you, we'll mark this as in-progress and loop in Finance for the credit application. Again, apologies — we'll include copies of the recount audit evidence in the postmortem.

Best,
Priyom Das
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
